cases.scenario: Signed-out visitor cannot open a signed-in screen or call the API
cases.given: A fresh browser with no session; a meeting exists

cases.scenario: Repeated wrong passwords for one email are throttled
cases.given: An active account; no sign-in attempts in the last minute
cases.when: Submit a wrong password 6 times within 60 seconds for that email; then the correct password inside the window; then again after Retry-After
cases.then: From the 6th attempt the form shows "Bạn đã thử quá nhiều lần. Vui lòng thử lại sau ít phút." (MSG414, HTTP 429 with Retry-After), also for the correct password inside the window; after the window the correct password signs in
cases.aiNote: SCRUM-132 · MSG414 · Run on a second local instance of the same build started with the shipped limits (5 per email, 60 per IP, 60 s), because Development raises them to 1000. Attempts 1–5: 401, 6: 429; correct password inside the window: 429 MSG414, Retry-After 60 s; after 62 s: 200. · Evidence: QA run SYS-NFR 20261122-184055 · Re-run on a clean local database: same result, QA run SYS-NFR 20261123-070126-0c98bde8 · Run by the QA runner on a local build of app 6baba24f.

cases.requirement: Role-based access control and least privilege
cases.scenario: Member cannot read a meeting they are not invited to by guessing its URL
cases.given: A published meeting of which Member D is not a participant; its URL copied from the Organizer's browser
cases.when: Signed in as Member D, open the copied URL; then call GET /api/meetings/{id} and an unknown id; search the list; call GET /api/users
cases.then: The page shows the same not-found screen as an unknown URL; the API answers 404 with the same body as for an unknown id, not 403, and the meeting does not appear in Member D's list; /api/users answers 403
cases.aiNote: 404 hides that the row exists (AGENTS.md 403/404 rule). Measured: meeting 404 = unknown id 404, list hits 0, /api/users 403. · Evidence: QA run SYS-NFR 20261122-184055 · Re-run on a clean local database: same result, QA run SYS-NFR 20261123-070126-0c98bde8 · Run by the QA runner on a local build of app 6baba24f.

cases.scenario: Secret document is not reachable through a guessed download link
cases.given: A Secret document attached to a meeting Member D is not on; its download link copied from an authorised browser

cases.scenario: Short passwords are refused, long passphrases accepted, and the password is never readable
cases.given: The Administrator creates accounts through POST /api/users
cases.when: Create one account with an 11-character password and one with the 27-character passphrase "mot hai ba bon nam sau bay"; sign in with the passphrase; read the stored hash, the user list and the audit details
cases.then: 11 characters are refused (400); the passphrase with spaces and no character classes is accepted and signs in; the database holds only a salted hash; neither the user list nor the audit log contains the password
cases.aiNote: Measured: 11 chars 400 MSG09; passphrase 201, sign-in 200; stored as an ASP.NET Identity v3 PBKDF2 hash (84 characters); passphrase absent from the user list and audit details. cases.when: Open the invitation link, verify the code, then try another meeting, the personal library and an expired code
cases.then: The code expires within 15 minutes; the guest acts as a Member in the invited meeting only; everything else is not found; no internal account is created
cases.aiNote: Report 3 §IV.2.3 fixed to 15 minutes to match the code (was 10 minutes). Measured 15-minute expiry: GuestAccessOptions CodeLifetimeMinutes = 15, no appsettings override; invitation mail and guest screen both show "Mã có hiệu lực trong 15 phút." (guest code sender, mail templates, docs/03-api/16-truy-cap-khach-uc04.md). cases.requirement: Protection of stored data and backups
cases.scenario: Stored files are reachable only through the app, secrets stay out of the repository, backups are daily and off-host
cases.given: A stored document and the deployment documentation
cases.when: Check that the storage service of the app server is not published outside its Docker network; look for a storage key in API answers; search committed settings for secrets; read the backup procedure in deploy/README.md
cases.then: The storage service is reachable only by the app; no API answer exposes a storage key; no secret is committed; the database and the stored files are backed up at least daily and kept apart from the production host
cases.aiNote: Backups per deploy, same host; files and recordings volumes not backed up. Storage key not exposed by any API; no secret in committed appsettings; the app server keeps files in a self-hosted SeaweedFS inside the Docker network with no published port (deploy/docker-compose.yml, service files; checked from the internet by the reviewer of PR 507). Not a defect: the dev SeaweedFS binds 127.0.0.1:8333 and has no authentication on purpose. Fails on backups (deploy/README.md): a pg_dump is taken on each deploy that changes the app image, kept on the same server ("Bản backup nằm cùng máy: mất máy là mất cả backup"), not daily and not off-host; only the database is dumped, the files and recordings volumes are not backed up at all. Bug: SCRUM-215. · Evidence: QA run SYS-NFR 20261122-184358 · Re-run on a clean local database: same result, QA run SYS-NFR 20261123-070126-0c98bde8. Note and defect corrected per review PR 507: the earlier "local bucket readable anonymously" finding was the dev service, and the app server does not use Cloudflare R2. · Run by the QA runner on a local build of app 6baba24f.
